description: This file defines a dialog for radio button configuration in CKEditor, including setup, content management, and attribute handling.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Prepares the dialog when shown, loading existing radio button data if selected.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Handles the creation or updating of the radio button element when the dialog is confirmed.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes dialog fields with the current element's attributes.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Saves dialog input back to the element's attributes.
